sloka: राजन् सततम् अध्यास्ते शरभो नाम यूथपः ।एतस्य बलिनः सर्वे विहारा नाम यूथपाः ॥६-२६-३७॥।।
transliteration: rājan satatam adhyāste śarabho nāma yūthapaḥ ।etasya balinaḥ sarve vihārā nāma yūthapāḥ ॥6-26-37॥।।

translations.english: "O King! Under him are forty lakhs of strong warriors known as Viharas."
